comment: The Watchlist wave-3 capture list: each ui-sim capture, the board it answers, the dev triggers armed in a fresh instance root, the mock state and the key walk. ONE CAPTURE RECIPE, automated by tools/watchlist_captures.py (`python3 tools/watchlist_captures.py --sim <plxnative-sim> [--out DIR] [--only FILE ...]`): (1) tests/mock_pms.py starts in that process on loopback with authorize_after=2, and `POST /_mock/discover {"list": <mock>}` resets its Discover list to the capture's `mock` mode (`default` is the 14-title fixture, `empty` clears the list, `movies_only` keeps only the movie titles so Type = TV Shows matches nothing); (2) a fresh instance root gets `plxnative-plextv` and `plxnative-discover` aimed at the mock, and a prep boot with `plxnative-login` signs in through the app's own QR flow - the stored mock session is the account, so no `token` trigger is armed (a `token` boot reads the Watchlist as unavailable for the profile); (3) the capture's `triggers` are armed, the simulator boots, waits `boot_wait_s`, sends each key as a FIFO token through `plxnative-remote` with `key_wait_s` between them (`hold` is `okdown`, 1.2 s, `okup`) and then `shot`; (4) the instance root's shot-N.png becomes `<output_dir>/<file>`, and a capture with `expect_write` fails unless the mock logged that write. `compare` names a baseline PNG (651035609 built the same way in a separate worktree) for the reader to put beside the new capture; the driver does not diff it. Build the simulator RELEASE, into a target dir outside the checkout: `cargo build --release --manifest-path rust-modules/Cargo.toml --target-dir <dir> --features hostsim --bin plxnative-sim` (the debug `make sim-macos` binary trips a `debug_assert` in ui/src/lib.rs:434, `a glass command was declared at/above the surfaces band`, on every frame a popover is up, and then draws no menu at all). Nothing reaches plex.tv, a real server or a television. The PNGs are scratch output, never committed.
baseline: 651035609 built the same way in a separate worktree and target dir; the *-base.png files
